Gabriela, you have to watch this. I finished the whole first season last night, and I did not sleep. It is only eight episodes, so it is a perfect weekend. The plot is a little strange at the beginning, and I almost stopped, because the first episode is slow and honestly a bit boring. But then, in episode three, everything changes, and it becomes really exciting. The actor who plays the brother is fantastic; he is only seventeen, and he is better than half the adults on television. I will not tell you the ending, because I do not want to give you a spoiler. Just promise me one thing: do not binge-watch it in one night like I did, because tomorrow you have school.

So, I watched the first two episodes yesterday and here is my recap. The plot is simple: a girl moves to a new town and she does not know anybody at school. In episode one she is completely alone, and honestly that part is a little boring, because nothing happens. But episode two is exciting, because she finds an old letter in her locker and the whole story changes. My favorite actor is the woman who plays the teacher. Her face says everything, and she almost never speaks. I will not talk about the ending of episode two, because I hate spoilers and Ryan hates them too. I want to binge-watch the rest this weekend, but my mother says I have to study first.
